subject: prd/feature-brainstorm
statement: The skill shall maintain the record as typed sections under a versioned template — idea verbatim, orientation summary, framings + destination, decisions, facts, fog (not-yet-specified, each entry typed blocking or non-blocking), out-of-scope rulings, candidate glossary terms, parked technical constraints, and the gate — each entry structured per the template's field contract.
rationale: the record is a cross-boundary artifact and must be contractual, not prose (AP-6); `prd-new` and the checklist parse it
fit_criterion: 100% of gated fixture records pass the record-structure checklist (every section present or explicitly empty; every decision row complete)
